rules.text:
**MUST** [[camp-again]]\
reuse_campaign_id replaces settings and recipients atomically only on an owned, never-launched voice draft or scheduled campaign. A launch claim prevents replacement. SMS creation always generates a fresh ID, even if the request forwards this field. Omit it for SMS.
rules.why: Draft replacement checks campaign ownership and launch state.

rules.instead: For another run create a campaign with a fresh ID, selected recipients and reviewed settings.
rules.value: Resume covers only unattempted work in the existing running launch, and neither resume nor reuse replays completed work.

rules.text: DELETE /v1/calls/batch/{id} deletes a voice campaign. Voice and SMS have separate cancel routes. Cancel stops future work. Running attempts may finish.
Use schedule_type=schedule, scheduled_date (YYYY-MM-DD), timezone, window_days and optional paired window_start_minutes/window_end_minutes. UTC date checks, local windows and capacity apply.
There is no scheduled_at promise of dispatch at an exact second.
rules.instead: Choose a date and a local window and track actual recipient status.

rules.text: Local window bounds are minutes since midnight. The accepted weekdays and minute range are shown below.
[[camp-again]] Voice deletion, cancellation and resume are separate operations. SMS has its own cancel and resume routes.
not_resumable means this campaign is outside the running launch state. Read its current state and create a new campaign for another run. [[camp-again]]

For one owned sender, send business_number (encode + as %2B) on GET /v1/campaigns or GET /v1/sms/campaigns. Omit for account scope. Keep the same number and status through SMS cursors. Restart paging if either changes. Voice include_totals=true covers returned campaigns only (default 50, max 200).

Pickup rate = answered attempts / all attempts, including failed starts. Answered means over five seconds with no detected voicemail. Sum counts before dividing. Zero attempts means no rate. SMS delivery rate = delivered / (delivered + failed).
